dedupe_keys.name: soil moisture data al khanasri restoration site

description: MELDATA publishes sensor observations from the Al-Khanasri restoration site in Jordan’s Badia, instrumented to evaluate mechanized micro-water harvesting using Vallerani pits. Acclima TR-315 probes record 30-minute series uphill, within pits, downhill and between pits, with depth profiles at 10, 30 and 100 cm below ground. Variables include volumetric water content, soil temperature, apparent permittivity and bulk and pore-water electrical conductivity. The provider explicitly identifies event-scale infiltration analysis and model validation as uses. Two sensor/data CSVs and three data dictionaries are listed. The description names 2022–2025, but structured coverage is 21 February 2023 to 28 July 2025; this date discrepancy remains unresolved. This is a separate site and period from the Al-Majeddyeh observations. Access: the native repository lists public files and free access under CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: no dataset files were downloaded; actual contents, completeness and numerical quality were not checked. Related resources are linked through the MELDATA parent collection.
